what_it_does: This paper presents a specialized phase-locked loop (PLL)—a chip circuit that generates precise frequencies—for FMCW radar systems used in autonomous vehicles and IoT devices. The PLL can rapidly switch between frequencies (11–16.4 GHz) with high accuracy, generating chirps (frequency sweeps) that are very linear. The key advance is a technique called digital predistortion that corrects distortion caused by the circuit itself, so the output stays extremely accurate (0.043% frequency error) and converges in just 5 radar chirp cycles, enabling fast multi-frequency hopping needed when multiple vehicles share the same radar band.
